title: A natural minor scale
summary: Change the gaps, keep A at home.

steps.title: A natural minor scale
steps.body:
**minor scale** means a scale with a different pattern from major. The **natural minor** form uses whole, half, whole, whole, half, whole, whole. A natural minor is A, B, C, D, E, F, G, A.

**Why it matters:** A different set of gaps gives you another sound while keeping a clear home note.

steps.title: Find the notes
steps.body: A to B is whole, B to C half, C to D whole, D to E whole, E to F half, F to G whole and G to A whole.

items.prompt: Play A, B, C, D, E, F, G, A in that order, one note at a time.

steps.title: Make it familiar
steps.body: Start on open string 5 for A2. Pause on C and F to hear where the two smaller gaps arrive.
